title: 1 Thessalonians Bible Quiz - Chapter 3
description: Ten questions on 1 Thessalonians 3: Timothy sent to Thessalonica, the glad news he brought back, and the prayer that closes the chapter.

questions.text: Where were they left behind alone?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says that when they could not stand it any longer, they thought it good to be left behind at Athens alone.

answers.text: At Corinth
At Athens
At Philippi
At Ephesus

questions.text: Whom did they send to establish and comfort the readers concerning their faith?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says they sent Timothy to establish them and to comfort them concerning their faith.

answers.text: Silvanus
Titus
Luke
Timothy

questions.text: How is Timothy described in verse 2?
questions.explanation: He is called their brother and God's servant in the Good News of Christ.

answers.text: Their brother and God's servant
An elder of the assembly at Athens
An apostle to the Gentiles
A teacher of the law

questions.text: What had they told the readers beforehand, while they were still with them?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says they told them beforehand that they are to suffer affliction, even as it happened.

answers.text: That the Lord would come at once
That no trouble would touch them
That they are to suffer affliction
That they would be rich in all things

questions.text: What was the writer afraid of when he sent to learn about their faith?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says he sent for fear that by any means the tempter had tempted them and their labor would have been in vain.

answers.text: That the letter had been lost
That they had left the city
That they had forgotten his name
That the tempter had tempted them

questions.text: What did Timothy bring back when he came to them?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says Timothy brought glad news of their faith and love, and that they have good memories of them always.

answers.text: A gift of money from the assembly
Glad news of their faith and love
A warning of coming persecution
News of a famine in Macedonia

questions.text: How does verse 8 complete the words “For now we live”?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says: “For now we live, if you stand fast in the Lord.”

answers.text: If you come to us at Athens
If you keep the traditions
If you stand fast in the Lord
If you send us help

questions.text: What did they pray night and day?
questions.explanation: Verse 10 says they prayed exceedingly night and day that they might see their face and perfect what is lacking in their faith.

answers.text: That they might see their face again
That the afflictions would end that day
That Timothy would stay with them
That they might travel to Judea

questions.text: Toward whom is the Lord asked to make their love increase and abound?
questions.explanation: Verse 12 asks the Lord to make them increase and abound in love toward one another and toward all men.

answers.text: Toward the apostles only
Toward one another and toward all men
Toward their own families only
Toward the assemblies in Judea

questions.text: At what moment are their hearts to be established blameless in holiness?
questions.explanation: Verse 13 says this is to the end that he may establish their hearts blameless in holiness at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all his saints.

answers.text: On the day Timothy returns
At the next gathering at Athens
On the day they were called
At the coming of our Lord Jesus
